finalText:
All objectives complete and verified.

## Final Report

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Ticket created with title `noesc3 RD Bench Ticket`, reference **RD-1015**, customer "Bench Test Customer", initial status **Draft**, created 2026-08-23.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Part `noesc3 RD Part A` added with cost **$100.00** and markup **25%**. App-computed price: **$125.00**.

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Part `noesc3 RD Part B` added with cost **$200.00** and markup **25%**. App-computed price: **$250.00**. Parts total at that point: $375.00.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Part A's cost edited from 100 → **$150.00** (markup kept at 25%). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50**. Ticket parts total became $437.50.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Ticket status set to **Ready**. Precondition discovered: the app rejected the first "Mark Ready" attempt with the exact alert:
> "Ticket is not ready. Part 'noesc3 RD Part A' has no supplier. Part 'noesc3 RD Part B' has no supplier."

What was required: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier assigned.** I satisfied this by editing Part A to supplier **"Acme Supplies"** and Part B to supplier **"PartsCo Ltd"** (both chosen from the form's supplier dropdown). After that, "Mark Ready" succeeded with no error — the status label read **Ready** and the buttons switched to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed". No confirmation toast was shown beyond the status change itself.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Both parts deleted (each via its delete dialog, confirmed); the parts table then showed **0 rows** and no total, with the ticket still in status Ready. The ticket was then archived via the "Archive ticket" button (alert dialog accepted; button changed to "Unarchive ticket"). Verified: with "Show archived" unchecked, no ticket containing "noesc3" appears on any page of the list (checked both pages, 13 tickets); with "Show archived" checked, RD-1015 appears as `noesc3 RD Bench Ticket Archived | Bench Test Customer | Ready | 0 parts | 2026-08-23`. Nothing created by this run remains active.
